# Document authority inventory

<!-- markdownlint-disable MD013 -->
<!-- GENERATED by scripts/knowledge/document-inventory.mjs — do not edit. -->
<!-- Regenerate: npm run knowledge:doc-inventory  ·  Verify: npm run knowledge:check -->

Every tracked Markdown file, and what kind of thing it is. **A report, not
an authority** — where this disagrees with `docs/HELM_OS.md` or with a
document's own header, they are right and the classifier needs fixing.

Input is `git ls-files`, never a filesystem walk: an internal `.worktrees/`
checkout once held more `.ts`/`.tsx` files than `src/` itself, and `find` does
not honour `.gitignore`. Tracked git state cannot contain a second checkout.

**Columns.** `routed` — reachable from `memory/registry.yml`. `authority?` —
the text contains "canonical", "source of truth" or "authoritative", which is
a prompt to check, not a verdict. `dead refs` — repo-relative paths named in
backticks that no tracked file matches.

There is deliberately no last-touch-SHA column: this file is tracked, so the
commit recording every other file's SHA would change them and a `--check`
gate would fail on its own commit. For per-file staleness use the rule
`.claude/rules/shipping.md` already sets — record an anchor SHA in the
document and run `git rev-list --count <sha>..HEAD -- <path>`.
